newsitem.title: USA: Penederm, Johnson & Johnson settle suit.
newsitem.headline: Penederm, Johnson & Johnson settle suit.

text.p: Penederm Inc. Thursday said it reached a settlement with Johnson & Johnson regarding a patent infringement suit filed by Johnson & Johnson against Penederm.

Under the terms of the agreement, Penederm has agreed not to market AVITA in gel formulation before the expiration of the Johnson & Johnson patent in January of 1998. AVITA gel and cream New Drug Applications for the treatment of acne are both currently pending Food and Drug Administration review. The Johnson & Johnson complaint did not affect the AVITA cream product.

The company said the FDA may grant contingent approval of the AVITA gel formulation, but it cannot allow commercialization of the product until the infringement suit is settled or the patent expires. In this case, the patent will expire before the suit is settled in a court of last appeal.
